Name: Jehoiada, High Priest
Summary: Jehoiada the priest, husband of Jehosheba, hid Joash six years, crowned him at seven, slew Athaliah, and instructed the king all his days.
KeyStory: Jehoiada crowns Joash and purges Baal.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram; Athaliah; Mattan, Priest of Baal
LifeLesson: One priest's six hidden years saved the house of David.
